channel.title: McCracken Land Services — U.S. Rig Count (Weekly)
channel.description: Weekly U.S. drilling rig count by state and basin from the public Baker Hughes North America Rig Count, with oil and gas prices and a plain-English read. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Baker Hughes.

item.title: U.S. Rig Count — week ending August 7, 2026
item.description: U.S. total 588 rigs, flat on the week (454 oil, 124 gas, +49 vs a year ago). WTI about $77, Henry Hub about $2.70. Full report and downloadable PDF at the link.
